name: Garden City Christmas Festival and Official Tree Lighting
when_note: Contest winners are announced at 5:45 PM, just before the main event begins.
paras: The city's annual festival fills the Town Green with a moonbounce, train rides, refreshments and giveaways. An ugly sweater contest adds a silly side, and Santa takes photos on the front steps of City Hall.
Children can also look over the entries in the city's tree decorating and gingerbread house contests before the tree is lit.
tip: Come before 6 PM to see the decorated trees and gingerbread houses before the crowd builds.

name: Richmond Hill 30th Annual Christmas Parade
venue: Timber Trail Recreation to City Hall
address: City Hall, 40 Richard R Davis Rd, Richmond Hill, GA 31324
when_note: The route runs from Timber Trail Recreation to City Hall, and the theme is Scenes of the Season.
paras: Floats, bands and community groups travel the route on a Saturday morning, which suits young children better than an evening parade. This is the city's 30th parade.
Last year's parade was canceled for weather, so the city moved it up to early December this time.
tip: Pick a spot near City Hall at the end of the route, where the floats slow down.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Vic's on the River
when_note: Three seatings run that Saturday: 10:30, 12:00 and 1:30. Doors open 20 minutes early.
paras: Each seating pairs a breakfast buffet of pancakes, French toast, eggs, bacon, sausage and fruit with a visit from Santa at the table. Santa reads The Night Before Christmas before the crafts begin.
Afterward, children can do holiday crafts, face painting, temporary tattoos and a letter to Santa dropped in his mailbox. Every child leaves with a gift bag, and tickets are not refundable.
tip: Book the earliest seating if your child naps in the afternoon, since the crafts follow the story.

name: A Very Maritime Holiday Party at Ships of the Sea
venue: Ships of the Sea Maritime Museum
address: 41 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Savannah, GA 31401
when_note: Santa arrives at 4:30 PM, and a live concert follows in the Maple Grove.
cost: $22 adults; $10 children; free for museum members
host: Ships of the Sea Maritime Museum
paras: The museum's holiday party fills its historic house and gardens with art projects, gingerbread sailboats and treats. Santa arrives at 4:30 PM, and hot chocolate is served while a local band plays holiday classics.
Parents can order Polar Champagne Punch while the children decorate. Tickets are sold online in advance.
tip: Arrive at 4:30 PM sharp if you want the first turn with Santa before the concert starts.

name: Holiday Family Programs at Ships of the Sea
venue: Ships of the Sea Maritime Museum
address: 41 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Savannah, GA 31401
when_note: Little Sailors Storytime is Dec. 19, Deck the Hulls drop-in crafts run Dec. 20, and the Holiday Harbor Club workshop for ages 8 and up is Dec. 21.
cost: Storytime and crafts included with museum admission; workshop $20, or $15 for members
ages: Storytime for little ones; workshop ages 8 and up
host: Ships of the Sea Maritime Museum
paras: Three small programs at the maritime museum fill the week before Christmas. The first is a cozy holiday story time for the youngest visitors, then a day of drop-in maritime crafts, then a drop-off art workshop for older children.
The Holiday Harbor Club workshop needs advance registration and runs only if at least eight children sign up. Parents can shop downtown with free parking while the artists work.
tip: Register for the Dec. 21 workshop early, since it only runs with eight or more children.

name: Santa on a Fire Truck in Pooler Neighborhoods
when_note: Santa visits a different part of the city each night, with make-up dates planned for bad weather. A live tracker shows where he is.
paras: Santa rides through Pooler on a fire truck from 6 to 9 PM, so families can watch from their own street instead of waiting in a line. The city's page lists the streets for each night.
The city also runs a live Santa Tracker, which helps children know when the truck is close.
tip: Check the street list for your night before leaving home, since each date covers different subdivisions.

name: Savannah Ice Rink at Tanger Outlets
when_note: The rink is open through Jan. 3, 2027. Hours are 3 to 9 PM Monday to Thursday, 3 to 10 PM Friday, 11 AM to 10 PM Saturday and 11 AM to 8 PM Sunday. Holiday hours are not published.
cost: $18 per skater with rental; $15 on select Mondays
paras: The outdoor rink beside the outlet center's lighthouse is open every day of the season, and skate rental is included in the ticket. Tickets are sold in 30-minute sessions.
The $15 Cheapskate Monday price applies on Nov. 30 and Dec. 7, 14, 21 and 28. A season pass costs $99.
tip: Book a Monday evening session for the lowest price and thinner crowds.
